SELECT tv.id, tv.tool_id AS toolId, tv.version, tv.protocol_version AS protocolVersion, tv.runtime_type AS runtimeType, tv.manifest_json AS manifestJson, tv.package_object_key AS packageObjectKey, tv.package_sha256 AS packageSha256, tv.signature, tv.status, tv.create_time AS createTime
FROM ya_tool_version tv
INNER JOIN ya_tool t ON t.tool_id = tv.tool_id
WHERE tv.tool_id = #{toolId} AND tv.version = #{version} AND t.status = 'ACTIVE'
LIMIT 1
